syllabus: This court will not take jurisdiction oyer an interlocutory decree.
summary: APPEAL EROM THE CIRCUIT COURT OE THE UNITED STATES EOR THE DISTRICT OE' IOWA.
attorneys: Mr. S. W. Fuller, Mr. B. C. Cook, Mr. Thomas F. Withrow, for appellants., Mr. James Grant for appellees.

opinions.author: Field
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Field

delivered the opinion of the court.

The decree in this case, made on the twenty-sixth day of May, 1869, is interlocutory and not final. The appeal from it must, therefore, be dismissed. Ordered accordingly.
